summary: Frontend-only regression for CCDP polish iteration 4. All 11 acceptance flows PASS. No fabricated data present, real leadership + faculty rendered, ANCRD module added, Culta fully removed, nav order matches spec, /ecosystem and /platform pages render correctly, hash cross-page nav + brand logo work, mobile menu navigates, contact form validates invalid email and clears on success with toast. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js ScrollManager uses fixed 80ms timeout for hash scroll — reliable in tests but consider rAF + short retry if a target renders lazily.
Footer contact form success text 'Thank you — we'll be in touch shortly.' works; consider adding data-testid on toast root for more robust assertions.
Radix Sheet has SheetTitle sr-only now — a11y warning gone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://studio-ancr.preview.emergentagent.com : NAV order = challenge, solution, ecosystem, platform, partnerships, investment, leadership, contact (all data-testids present). Home ecosystem-section has node-ancr + 12 modules including node-ancrd; NO node-culta. Clicking node-ancrd updates ecosystem-detail with 'ANCRD' + 'Artist discovery & development'. Impact section shows 5 impact-placeholder-* cards; NO 50K/100+/500+/92% strings anywhere in body. Leadership section: leader-mcmillan/shimpan/king/wilson/griffin + music-parker/fletcher + faculty-section (Coming Soon). Partners: 8 partner-category-* placeholders, NO Adobe/Spotify/Google/Apple/Microsoft in body. FinalCTA cta-0..4 texts confirmed as spec. /ecosystem shows ecosystem-page-hero + org-academy/ancr/adca/vaulta. /platform shows platform-hero + branch-platform-ancrd, NO branch-platform-culta. Hash nav from /platform via nav-link-contact goes to /#contact. brand-logo returns to /. Mobile 390px: mobile-menu-trigger opens sheet; mobile-nav-link-ecosystem -> /ecosystem. Contact form (data-testid=contact-input/contact-submit): 'notanemail' triggers invalid toast; valid email 'partner@university.edu' triggers success toast and clears input. Zero console errors.
